eventsIntro: Create timed gold and XP modifiers. An event applies only while active and inside its start and end times.
name: Name
saveError: The event could not be saved. Check its key, dates, and modifiers.
deleteError: The event could not be deleted.
actionError: The event status could not be changed.
startsBeforeEnds: The end time must be after the start time.
unsupportedEventHint: Read-only until implemented. This legacy type has no gold or XP runtime effect.
dissolveError: The alliance could not be dissolved.
eraStartAdminOnly: Starting an era requires an administrator.
analyticsCaveat: Registration and attack counts use retained records. Activity groups each player by their latest activity; it is not historical daily active users. Older attack records may have been pruned.

eraReset.description: Reset the current era, {{name}}. You choose the starting values in the confirmation step.
eraReset.losses: This permanently resets every player's current-era progress, including staff: gold, units, items, structures, XP, rank, testing data, alliance treasury, alliance XP and upgrades, and current-era histories.
eraReset.retained: Account identity, lifetime achievements, account moderation history, staff access, guild identity and rosters, social data, messages, and past eras are kept.
eraReset.baseline: Every account is reset to these starting values, which are also saved as the era's starting settings.
eraReset.enableLoginsDescription: Reopen player logins after the reset succeeds. Leave unchecked to keep them closed.
eraReset.maintenanceNote: Maintenance remains enabled. Enabling logins does not end maintenance.
eraReset.requestError: The current era could not be reset. Please retry.
eraReset.runtimeConfigError: Login settings could not be checked.
eraReset.automaticClosure: Player access closes automatically when you confirm. The reset runs after a brief 35-second pause, then reopens logins if selected. No settings change is needed.

eraSchedule.title: Schedule Era reset
eraSchedule.description: Announce a reset time to everyone. At that time, player logins close, the current Era resets to its saved starting settings, and logins can reopen.
eraSchedule.dateHelp: OT Time is the clock shown in the sidebar, so enter the time as you see it there. Choose a time at least one minute ahead.
eraSchedule.started: The Era reset has started. Player logins are closed while the reset completes.
eraSchedule.requestError: The schedule could not be updated. Retry after reloading.
eraSchedule.loadError: The reset schedule could not be loaded.
eraSchedule.dateTooSoon: Choose a time at least one minute ahead.
eraSchedule.preview: Era will reset on {{utc}} ({{local}} on your own clock).
eraSchedule.timeInvalid: Enter a 24-hour time such as 18:30 or 18:30:00.
